person_note: The controlling narrator is protagonist Stephanie Plum, who narrates as I. Multiple Goodreads event passages independently expose her actions, memories, judgments, and bodily experience in first person, while dialogue-only first-person forms were excluded. The authorized Chapter One excerpt confirms the same sustained voice, and an explicit secondary description characterizes the book as first person. No credible evidence of sustained sections in another narrative person was found; the main scope limitation is that the authorized continuous excerpt covers only the opening, but the interior Goodreads passages corroborate it.
